name: pedra-mcp
display_name: Pedra — AI Real Estate Photo & Video Editing
description: AI real-estate photo and video editing: virtual staging, renovation, room emptying, enhancement, sky replacement, object removal/blur, property videos, and hosted 360° virtual tours via the Pedra API.
long_description: Pedra brings AI real-estate media editing into Claude. One tool per Pedra API endpoint — virtual staging (furnish), renovation, empty room, photo enhancement, perspective correction, natural-language editing, sky replacement, object removal, privacy blur, property video generation, and hosted 360° virtual tours (AI names the rooms and links them; upload 360° photos straight from your disk). Photo and video tools are single blocking calls that return the final image or video URL; virtual tours build in the background and are polled. Uses your Pedra API key (PEDRA_API_KEY, in Settings at https://app.pedra.ai). No account yet? Leave the key empty: Claude can create one for you with pedra_request_access, and you confirm by email.

api_key.title: Pedra API Key
api_key.description: Your Pedra API key, from Settings at https://app.pedra.ai. Optional: without it, Claude can get you a key (and create your account if you don't have one) with pedra_request_access; you confirm by email. Paste the key here afterwards to keep it.

tools.name: pedra_enhance

tools.name: pedra_enhance_and_correct_perspective

tools.name: pedra_empty_room
tools.description: Remove all furniture and objects from a room.

tools.name: pedra_furnish
tools.description: Virtually stage (furnish) a room with AI-generated furniture.

tools.name: pedra_renovation
tools.description: Renovate a space (walls, floors, finishes), optionally furnished.

tools.name: pedra_edit_via_prompt

tools.name: pedra_sky_blue
tools.description: Replace a dull or overcast sky with a clear blue one.

tools.name: pedra_remove_object

tools.name: pedra_blur

tools.name: pedra_create_video

tools.name: pedra_update_video

tools.name: pedra_generate_voice_script

tools.name: pedra_generate_voice
tools.description: Turn a script into a voiceover audio track.

tools.name: pedra_music_library

tools.name: pedra_list_properties
tools.description: List the account's properties (read-only).

tools.name: pedra_list_property_images
tools.description: List a property's photos or 360° photos as URLs (read-only).

tools.name: pedra_create_property
tools.description: Create a property.

tools.name: pedra_add_images_to_property

tools.name: pedra_add_local_panoramas

tools.name: pedra_create_upload_link

tools.name: pedra_get_virtual_tour

tools.name: pedra_list_virtual_tours

tools.name: pedra_update_virtual_tour

tools.name: pedra_add_virtual_tour_scenes

tools.name: pedra_credits
tools.description: Read the account's plan and remaining credits (read-only).

tools.name: pedra_feedback
tools.description: Submit thumbs up/down feedback on a generated image.

tools.name: pedra_request_access
tools.description: Only without an API key: get the user a Pedra account/API key; they confirm by email.

tools.name: pedra_check_access
tools.description: Only without an API key: check the access request; once approved, every tool works for the session.
